round8Status: Fixed: one key per mention, so a timed-out Retry in another mode leaves one copy; the sweep settles an overtaken attempt left pending; the doc passages are corrected except comment_delivery.go:672-677. The #2392 horizon merge holds: relay, resume, overflow catch-up and GET /api/v1/events/log read up to the horizon with no skip or duplicate. refreshHeldClaims records only over the claim it read.

keyFindings.description: CommentMentionIdempotencyKey changed from main's `<comment>:<target>:<mode>` to `<comment>:<target>`, and the listener derives the dedupe key verbatim (cmd/listener/api.go:574-578). A mention the previous build delivered and did not settle, resent by this build's sweep, or a same-mode Retry of an old receipt-timeout attempt, reaches the session again with duplicate:false; the outbox's copy for an old failed attempt does too. The window is the 72 h MentionSweepWindow / duplicate window after the deploy; Recreate does not avoid it. Reproduced in two scratch tests. Fix: key by the mention's own mode, `<comment>:<target>:<comment_mentions.delivery>` (attempt 1 is always in that mode), which equals main's key for every automatic send and keeps one key per mention, so the round-8 fix holds.

Docs: delivery_sweep.go:87-95 lists a stood-down attempt among the outbox's resumed ones and says the copy is held back for every attempt a send is still coming for, and model.go:1445-1450 says an abandoned attempt has no send coming; a stood-down attempt reads abandoned while its Retry is in flight and becomes the sweep's owed attempt once the Retry fails. comment_delivery.go:672-677 says nothing else settles an overtaken attempt; settleSupersededMentions now does. events.go:22-24 says the overflow catch-up pages at maxEventReplay; it reads at maxLiveReplay (live_events.go:312).
The risk bullet on the fallback copy still names the key `agent.<session>.<comment>:<target>:<mode>` and says a retry in another mode is delivered; under b423cb71 both are false.
